name: Inis: Legendary Edition

categories.label: Holds a pretender token at the check for victory
categories.labelVi: Có thẻ Pretender khi kiểm tra chiến thắng
categories.hint: Only pretender-token holders can win; checked at Assembly step 2.

categories.label: Chieftain over 6+ opposing clans
categories.hint: Total opposing clans in territories where you are chieftain; deeds add +1 each (wild).

categories.label: Present in territories with 6+ sanctuaries
categories.labelVi: Hiện diện ở vùng có tổng 6+ thánh địa
categories.hint: Sum sanctuaries in territories where you have 1+ clans (chieftain or not); deeds +1 each.

categories.label: Present in 6+ territories
categories.hint: Territories with 1+ of your clans; deeds +1 each.

categories.label: Is the Brenn (tie-breaker)
categories.hint: Brenn wins ties for most conditions; if Brenn is not among the tied, nobody wins that round.

tiebreakers.description: If Brenn is among players tied for most victory conditions, Brenn wins; otherwise no winner and the game continues another round.

winCondition: Only at Assembly step 2 (Check for Victory), among players holding a pretender token, the one meeting the most of the 3 victory conditions (at least 1) is High King and wins. If no pretender holder meets any, or a tie excludes the Brenn, there is no winner: return pretender tokens and play another round.

endCondition.description: Ends when a pretender holder wins at the Check for Victory step; no fixed round limit.

notes: family: area-majority (victory-condition race). No points. Scorer ticks which of the 3 conditions the pretender holder meets (after adding deeds as wild +1). Rules read from the earlier Matagot edition PDF (v2.2 summary + base rulebook); the 2025 Legendary Edition rulebook could not be fetched, so unchanged victory conditions are assumed. Seasons of Inis expansion alternative victory modules not modelled.
